Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in interweaving 2D Co-corrole COF layers with bidentate molecular pillars (pyrazine, bipyridine) via axial Co–N coordination, expanding interlayer spacing from 4.2 Å to 6.4/10.3 Å. This boosts active-site accessibility and mass transport, markedly enhancing 4e⁻ ORR activity (half-wave potential up to 0.94 V) and durability. Significance: a pillar-interweaving strategy for high-performance COF electrocatalysts, demonstrated by a Zn-air battery outperforming Pt/Ru benchmarks.

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a site-separated polymer binder that selectively confines I₂ and I⁻ at distinct side-chain groups, chemically blocking polyiodide formation at its source. This enables direct I₂/I⁻ conversion, superior rate performance (102 mAh g⁻¹ at 50 A g⁻¹), and 97.1% retention over 31,000 cycles—significantly advancing stable aqueous Zn–I₂ battery cathodes.
